EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION


Commission Meeting--Sunshine Act Notice

TIME AND DATE: Wednesday, August 26, 2026, 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time.

PLACE: The meeting will be held at the Jacqueline A. Berrien Training 
Center, 131 M Street NE, Washington, DC 20507. The meeting will also be 
held as a listen-only audio. The public may attend in person or connect 
to the audio only by following the instructions that will be posted on 
<a href="http://www.eeoc.gov">www.eeoc.gov</a> at least 24 hours before the meeting. ASL services will be 
available for those attending the meeting in person and a closed 
captioning link will be posted on our website prior to the meeting.
    If you wish to attend the meeting in person, you must email 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#bbd8d4d6d6d2c8c8d2d4d5d6dedecfd2d5dcd8d4d6d6ded5cfc8fbdeded4d895dcd4cd"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="b5d6dad8d8dcc6c6dcdadbd8d0d0c1dcdbd2d6dad8d8d0dbc1c6f5d0d0dad69bd2dac3">[email&#160;protected]</span></a> to register by providing your name 
as it appears on your driver's license or other government-issued 
identification at least 24 hours prior to the meeting. You will be 
asked to show your ID upon arrival.

STATUS: The meeting will be open to the public.

MATTERS TO BE CONSIDERED: The following items will be considered at the 
meeting:

<bullet> EEOC Strategic Plan for Fiscal Years 2026-2030
<bullet> Draft Notice of Proposed Rulemaking--Revision of Federal-
sector EEO Complaint Regulations (29 CFR part 1614)

NOTE:  In accordance with the Sunshine Act, the public will be able to 
observe the Commission's deliberations and voting. (In addition to 
publishing notices on Commission meetings in the Federal Register, the 
Commission also provides information about Commission meetings on its 
website, <a href="http://www.eeoc.gov">www.eeoc.gov</a> and provides a recorded announcement one week in 
advance of future Commission meetings.) Public observation does not 
include participation. Observers seeking to take still photographs, 
video, or audio recordings of the meeting must seek permission by 
contacting the Executive Secretariat at 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#b4d7dbd9d9ddc7c7dddbdad9d1d1c0dddad3d7dbd9d9d1dac0c7f4d1d1dbd79ad3dbc2"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="c5a6aaa8a8acb6b6acaaaba8a0a0b1acaba2a6aaa8a8a0abb1b685a0a0aaa6eba2aab3">[email&#160;protected]</span></a> at least 24 hours before the meeting 
to discuss the manner of recording and ensure it does not interfere 
with the meeting.
    Please telephone (202) 921-2705, or email 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ddbeb2b0b0b4aeaeb4b2b3b0b8b8a9b4b3babeb2b0b0b8b3a9ae9db8b8b2bef3bab2ab"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="5635393b3b3f25253f39383b3333223f383135393b3b33382225163333393578313920">[email&#160;protected]</span></a> at any time for information on this 
meeting.

CONTACT PERSON FOR MORE INFORMATION: Raymond Windmiller, Executive 
Officer, (202) 921-2705.

    Dated: August 19, 2026.
Raymond D. Windmiller,
Executive Officer, Executive Secretariat.
